name: code_tests
description: Find the test files and test functions that exercise a symbol (transitive callers, depth 2). Use this to run targeted tests for the code you changed instead of the full suite. Prefer this over Grep for test discovery -- the call graph is pre-indexed. Scope: always the calling session's own repo -- a member session uses its registered work folder; any other session uses the first MCP client root (roots/list) that is a git repository with an origin remote -- the same root its kb_* tools use -- or the fleet server's working folder when the client offers no roots. Extension for code tools only: when roots are offered and none has an origin remote, the first offered git repository is used (kb_* tools then fail with E-SELF-NO-REMOTE). There is no repo/path scope argument. Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER or E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO when that folder is missing or is not a git repository, E-CODE-INDEX-NOT-READY when it has no usable code index yet (a missing or interrupted index gets a build requested automatically -- retry shortly) or the index is still building (that error result's structuredContent carries retry_after_ms -- wait that long once, retry once, then fall back; never poll code_status in a loop -- plus retry_will_help and, while an analyze runs, its progress), and E-CODE-INTEL-DISABLED when code intelligence is off (each with a one-line remediation).
